purpose: Determine the physically reachable post-runoff topology before imposing another h0=0 event equation. Starting from the four frozen A4 surface-cap checkpoints, use independent reference fluxes only to measure the initial top-cell tendency, follow a bounded conservative fixed-head trajectory, and solve the common post-cap unsaturated steady state under h_surface=1 cm and h_bottom=-15 cm.

fixed_post_cap_boundary.meaning: Once the surface cap is active, atmospheric excess changes the runoff ledger; the soil trajectory is governed by the fixed 1 cm surface head and bottom head.

reference_authority.surface_face: Independent high-accuracy 5 cm surface reference for h_surface=1 and h0<0.
reference_authority.internal_faces: Independent reference internal-face fluxes on 10 cm faces.
reference_authority.reason: A6 diagnoses physical reachability/topology, not candidate accuracy.

part_A_initial_tendency.interpretation: q_top-q_01<0 means the top cell initially loses water after cap onset; >0 means it initially wets.

part_B_transient.method: reference-only conservative backward Euler in head state
part_B_transient.hard_event_check: Any accepted step with h0>=-1e-6 cm is recorded as TOP_SATURATION_APPROACH and prevents an unsaturated-attractor conclusion.

runoff_accounting.runoff_rate_each_transient_step: q_supply-q_top; must be nonnegative while S=1 cm

decision_logic.unsaturated_attractor: All four initial top tendencies are nonpositive, all 56-step trajectories remain below h0=-1e-6 with conservative reference balances, and a reproducible unsaturated steady root exists with h0<-1e-4. Then isolated post-cap h0=0 is not the next reachable event under this frozen O14 boundary topology.
decision_logic.top_saturation_reachable: Any conservative trajectory approaches/crosses the frozen h0 threshold or no reproducible unsaturated steady root exists. Then preserve the relevant profile/time evidence and design an event gate from the actual trajectory rather than from A5 direct-event algebra.
decision_logic.inconclusive: Any reference-step/root failure prevents a physical conclusion; diagnose the reference trajectory/steady solver without changing the frozen states or boundary.

hard_guards: Do not change the four A4 cap states, O14 hydraulics, h_surface=1 cm or h_bottom=-15 cm.
Do not use the failed A5 direct h0=0 equation as evidence of impossibility by itself.
Do not infer production solver performance from this reference-only diagnostic.
Do not add or persist event time/state per column.
Runoff remains an explicit external ledger transfer, never hidden clipping.
Do not tune the transient schedule or steady starts after seeing results inside A6.

architecture_checks.3_explicit_data_separation: Committed cap heads, fixed boundary, transient scratch, runoff ledger and diagnostics remain separate.
architecture_checks.7_transactional_timesteps: Every diagnostic step is solved from the previous accepted reference state; failed trial states are not substituted or clipped.
architecture_checks.9_generic_time: All times are generic day-valued intervals, not calendar boundaries.
architecture_checks.13_mass_conservation_absolute: Every accepted transient step must close each cell within 1e-9 cm without repair.
architecture_checks.28_runtime_composition: Runoff ownership remains outside the soil kernel.
